correctness.rationale: The disk criterion is exactly the vanishing trace-free compression, with two observable Fourier coefficients. The key rank-two lemma uses eigenvector comparisons, simultaneous diagonalization under hypothetical rank defect, then a three-index noncollinear plane with a nonzero 2-by-2 determinant. Greedy rank drops from D to zero in ceil(D/2) stages; nonzero analytic minors give full-measure generic tuples. Codomain rank bounds and the strict support-curvature formula produce smooth nonball witnesses for every shorter tuple. Modular exact-rank tests in dimensions 3–12 are finite supporting checks only.
